verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents built-in protections for two of the three threats. Its overview describes blocking suspicious IPs after consecutive failed login attempts, which covers brute force. Breached-password detection that can notify or block compromised users, backed by a database of compromised assets, targets credential stuffing and account takeover. Adaptive MFA risk-based prompting and SMS fraud protection with exponential backoff (Enterprise plans) add further layers. missing for 10: any evidence of bot detection or CAPTCHA on auth flows, in-depth configuration docs for brute-force and breached-password protection, independent or hands-on corroboration that these protections work.
